design: An adult female harpy hunter adversary, sharp angular human-like face, medium narrow amber eyes, fierce brows, hooked nose and hostile smug expression, shaggy dark-auburn hair with a few feather tufts. Modest brown feathered/leather bodice covering torso and rough belt/hip feather skirt. Exactly TWO LARGE feathered WING-ARMS instead of human arms, and TWO bird talon legs; no separate human hands/extra arms. Ochre/dark-brown feather palette and long curved talons, same anatomy all16frames. Three-quarter flying toward RIGHT, stylized fantasy comic villain matching player art, not adorable or sensual. Idle wingbeats with torso fixed, hurt folds wings and flinches, attack raises talon then kicks/rakes toward RIGHT, dodge banks backward and lowers body before returning. Entire wings and claws safely within spacious transparent cells.
